sc: 50 Shades of Dye is a joke item available from Balthazar's Bargain Barrel in October 2015.
Airut bones are the remains of airut, obtained when an airut is killed.

A player choosing to use airut bones all the way from 1-99 Prayer, using a gilded altar with lit burners and no other experience boosts, would, if all the bones were bought at the current medium price on the Grand Exchange, spend .
Ancient Necronium Shortbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 42 of the Expedition to the Wilderness Yak Track while having access to premier rewards.
The Third Age-dyed augmented Imperium core is a level 92 Magic weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Imperium core (Third Age), or by using Third age dye on an augmented imperium core.
The augmented khopesh of Elidinis is a tier 92 off-hand melee weapon, made by using an augmentor on the khopesh of Elidinis.
Bandos's Memories is a book gained as a reward for completing The Mighty Fall.
Memory 1 is unlocked by default, while the others must be unlocked by catching the 13 Bandos chronicles scattered throughout Bandos' Arena, granting 10 Divination experience each.
Banner fragments were a reward from the Invasion of Falador, obtainable through supply caches.
The Between a Rock Mining XP lamp is a lamp rewarded for completion of the Between a Rock.
A total of 1,000 Holly wreaths could be obtained by pulling a Glowing cracker.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 primal bars and primal armoured boots + 3, requiring 1,540 progress to complete, granting a total of 11,200 Smithing experience.

v: Only before completing the Lost Her Marbles miniquest.
sc: It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bronze bars, requiring 200 progress to complete, granting a total of 30 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny spiky bronze salvage by the spring cleaner.

r: Partial completion of The Needle Skips
sc: They can be made by grinding a buckthorn leaf, and are used to wake up Primrose.
It can be made by using the anvil on Bill Teach's ship, The Adventurous, with a cannonball, heated chain and hammer in your inventory.
Carmine Necromancer Gloves is a hand slot cosmetic override that was obtained by using 120 Keys during the Mysteria daily bonus reward promotion.

Chaos Witch Adept robe top.x: Chaos Witch Adept robe top is a torso slot cosmetic override. It is unlocked by alongside the Chaos Witch Adept hat by defeating Zamorak, Lord of Chaos at 500% enrage.

sc: It can be made by attaching 5 chaotic spikes to a dragon claw.
Chaotic spikes can be purchased as a reward from the Dungeoneering skill for 20,000 Dungeoneering tokens apiece (for a total of 100,000 Dungeoneering tokens to create one chaotic claw).
It is obtained by fletching the cinnamon twigs which are in turn obtained by harvesting twigs on the cinnamon tree.
Each of the different twigs are found on each of the five dungeons leading towards the lair.

Clue scroll (hard) - Salute in the banan.x: Clue scroll (hard) is an emote clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: Clue scroll (medium) is a map clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
A Constitution XP lamp is awarded when defeating the Hobgoblin Champion.
Constitution XP lamp is a reward for completing Song from the Depths.

Corrupt Morrigan's leather chaps are a part of the Corrupt Morrigan's Equipment PvP armour set, obtained from killing Revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon, or as a very rare drop from the Chaos Elemental.
The Cramulet is an amulet made by the player after the Do No Evil quest by combining the Cramulet with the Catspeak amulet.
Dropping all cramulets and cat speak amulets will allow you to obtain a new one from the Sphinx and then pick the old ones up from the ground.

Death Lotus training scroll.x: The death lotus training scroll is an item involved with the Death Lotus Training Treasure Hunter promotion. It is used to view the tasks for the event.

Death Reaper Boots.x: The Death Reaper Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Death Reaper Vestments outfit. They can be unlocked by purchasing the Death Reaper Vestments Set. They are an upgraded version of the Death Bringer Boots, unlocked by completing 25 Slayer assignments while having any Death Seeker or Death Bringer cosmetic active.

sc: A Defence XP lamp is given as a reward for completing A Shadow over Ashdale.
Enchanted diamond bolts are items made by enchanting diamond bolts with the level 57 Magic spell Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Diamond), enchanting 10 bolts at a time.
The enchanted bolts are made from adamant bolts and tipped with diamond bolt tips, requiring level 65 Fletching.

Drakewing Head.x: Drakewing Head is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Drakewing set.

sc: Fletcher's headwear is a reward from Stealing Creation.
The item was originally created from 500 lightweight feathers when these were obtainable between 10 March 2016 to 14 March 2016 as an exclusive prize from Treasure Hunter.

sc: They are affiliated with Zamorak and are dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth.

Golden Armadyl godsword (passive).x: The Golden Armadyl godsword (passive) is created by using an Golden Armadyl godsword on the altar in Kree'arra's room. This process can be repeated to turn the sword back to normal.

Golden Verac's helm.x: The Golden Verac's helm is a helmet that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle from 2015 onward. It is part of the Golden Verac the Defiled's equipment set and acts exactly like the normal variant but is golden in colour.

w: History of the first six partyhats
sc: The green partyhat is an item that was originally obtained by opening a Christmas cracker during the 2001 Christmas event.
Ground charcoal is an item obtained by grinding normal charcoal with a pestle and mortar.

Heavenforged Warrior platebody.x: The Heavenforged Warrior platebody is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Heavenforged Warrior Armour. It can be obtained, along with the rest of the outfit, by redeeming a Heavenforged Warrior Armour Token or by purchasing the outfit from the Marketplace.

sc: The Hourglass was a members-only reward from the seasonal quest Deathcon II.
A hydrix ring is a ring made by crafting a gold bar with a hydrix at level 79 Crafting, giving 130 experience.
Ilu the Bird of Paradise is a companion pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing task 36 of Journey to Iaia.
The Incomplete obsidian idol (with the body, arms and legs) is created by combining an obsidian idol body, obsidian idol arms and obsidian idol legs.
During The Eyes of Glouphrie, it may be obtained from Brimstail by talking to him.
During The Path of Glouphrie, it may be found in Gnome Village Dungeon.
and thok letter (part 2) is a book obtained while training Dungeoneering as a reward for completing a dungeon which appears by the exit door after the boss monster is killed.
It can also be obtained as a monster drop from monsters in Daemonheim.
Once the book has been obtained once it is impossible to obtain it again.
Mahjarrat's Ritual Outfit is a cosmetic override set unlocked by completing tier 38 of The Winter Trials.
It can be obtained after completing the miniquest Rogue Trader.

Musketeer's hat (green, female).x: The green musketeer's hat is part of the musketeer outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Necromancy potions are potions made by adding cadava berries to a marrentill potion (unfinished), giving 50 Herblore experience and requiring 11 Herblore.
Novite ore can be found in the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.

Perfect mead.x: Perfect mead is an unobtainable item. During the event The Need for Mead, Leslie was trying to make the best mead on Gielinor. In the fifth task given to players, Leslie revealed that he finally managed to make the perfect mead.

sc: Pink robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.
Poison detection potion (strange spices) can be created by using an unheated poison detection potion (strange spices) on the range in the Kitchen in Fort Forinthry.
It can be created with 40 gleaming energy and 55 Divination inside of a dungeon of high complexity.
It can be made at a forge and anvil from a primal pickaxe using 2 primal bars at 100 Smithing, requiring 1,760 progress to complete, granting a total of 2,800 Smithing experience.
A rainbow trail aura token is an item that can be redeemed to unlock the Rainbow Trail aura.
It can be obtained from various occurrences of the Rainbow Trail promotion on Treasure Hunter since 13 June 2024.

h: Via the Advent Calendar (2021) on 1, 12, and 22 December
sc: Rainbow Wings is a wing slot cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a Rainbow wings token.
It is obtained from Emir Ali Mirza, who can be found in the Al Kharid palace.
If the report is lost or destroyed, it can be re-obtained by talking to Emir Ali Mirza again in the Al Kharid palace.
It can be obtained from the tools cupboard in the Exam Centre.
It is also given to the player after passing their second test during the quest.
It is obtained by using a chisel to carve the 32kg block of sandstone given to the player by Lazim in the desert south of the Bandit Camp.

Sandwich Seller's Bottoms.x: The Sandwich Seller's Bottoms are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Sandwich Lady Bundle.

sc: The scrimshaw of attack is an item that can be made within a player-owned port workshop once all four scroll pieces of the scrimshaw have been obtained.
The Shadow Gem Pernix Token is a Treasure Hunter reward from the Crystal Capsules promotion.
During the 2025 Christmas event, it can also be obtained from Santa's Christmas Presents.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Shadow Gem Sack, destroying the token after a confirmation prompt.
Therefore, if players were ever able to obtain the item they would be unable to profit.

Sharpening stone.x: Sharpening stone is an item that can be consumed with the "Sharpen axe" option which removes the item and yields the sharpening stone buff, additively increasing the chance of Perfect Cuts by 5% when cutting eternal magic trees. It can be obtained from enchanted bird's nests.

sc: Sheratan Staff is a two-handed magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 15 of Zodiyak Track with the premier pass.
Short Green Guy (commonly abbreviated to SGG) is a Gnome cocktail that can be made at level 20 Cooking, granting 120 Cooking experience.

Sir Owen Longsword.x: The Sir Owen Longsword is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Sir Owen pack.

Small doggy bones.x: Small doggy bones can be found in the Draynor Manor graveyard after progressing through Death's dogwalker's miniquest in the 2020, the 2021, and the 2022 Halloween events.

sc: Springbloom Witch Hat is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by redeeming a Springbloom Witch Hat token or directly from the Potion Pandemonium Treasure Hunter promotion.
Materials may be gathered by pickpocketing a Trainee archaeologist at level 50 Thieving, though the archaeologists found at the Warforge Dig Site still require level 76 to reach.
Tetracompass pieces can come from research by sending out Mr Mordaut on the research team.
They are obtained by hacking medium jungle with a machete, earning favour at the same time.
The Red Devil is a book found in the Grand Library of Menaphos.
It is obtained from the first bookcase north of the western stairs on the third level going to the second level.
It is found in a crate in the storage area of the secret bunker on the iceberg on RuneScape France worlds.
The blueprints for the master farmer outfit must first be purchased from Granny Potterington at the Farmers' Market for 1,000 beans.
They can be traded, but only for other master farmer outfit pieces.

Tribal Circlet.x: The Tribal Circlet is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Tribal outfit. It is the override equivalent of the Tribal ringlet item.

sc: Trout is a food item that can be made by cooking a raw trout at level 15 Cooking over a fire or a cooking range, yielding 70 Cooking experience per trout on a range (or 77 Cooking experience on a bonfire), which can be consumed to heal 375 life points.
Unheated poison detection potion (hollyhock) can be created by mixing a base poison detection potion and hollyhock during Murder on the Border.

The rewards unlocked with Valentine hearts were split into Love and Hate rewards:
Love
• Love at First Sight emote - 1,750 hearts
• Cupid bow (members only) - 1,000 hearts
• Lovestruck pendant (members only) - 750 hearts
Hate
• Jealous Rage emote - 1,750 hearts
• Rosethorn wand and Broken heart (members only) - 1,000 hearts
• Heartbreak pendant (members only) - 750 hearts
Chocolates, a neutral reward, could be received by trading in 50 hearts.
There are six different chocolates, all of which could be won on the Squeal of Fortune or bought with Valentine hearts. Each of these six chocolates heals 200 life points and gives a temporary +1 to +3 boost to a specific skill, as listed here:
• Noisette triangle key - Dungeoneering
• Chilli chocolate - Firemaking
• Coconut cream - Herblore (members only)
• Dwarven delight - Mining & Smithing
• Rose essence truffle - Runecrafting
• Vanilla fudge log - Woodcutting
The total cost of the Love or Hate rewards was 3,500 for all emotes and 7,000 for all rewards excluding chocolate.
sc: A Valentine heart was a seasonal item that could be won on the Squeal of Fortune, obtained through skilling, received as a drop from a monster, or traded with other players.
Upon obtaining Valentine hearts from skilling or a monster drop, players received the following message in their chat box: They were only available from 14 February 2013 to 25 February 2013.
Parts for all 5 base lamp types are found while skilling or in combat.

Werewolf claws (dark grey, male).x: The dark grey werewolf claws are part of the werewolf costume item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

sc: A workshop issued adamant ingot IV is an item that can be purchased in the bonus package from Elof in the Artisans' Workshop for 100% Respect which contains 4 workshop issued adamant ingot IVs.
It can be made into a workshop issued adamant ingot (heated) by heating it in a furnace in the main area of the Artisans' Workshop, while having tongs in the inventory.
